name: nextjs-app-router-patterns
description: Next.js 14+ App Router: RSC, streaming, routing, caching, SSR/SSG, Server Actions; apps, migrations, full-stack features, optimization.
Rendering: Server Components for data/computation/secrets; Client Components for interactivity/hooks/browser APIs. Static stable content; Dynamic personalized/live data. Stream large/slow pages.
Files: `layout.tsx` shared; `page.tsx` route; `loading.tsx` loading; `error.tsx` boundary; `not-found.tsx` 404; `route.ts` API; `template.tsx` remount; `default.tsx` parallel fallback; `opengraph-image.tsx` OG.
Examples: `app/layout.tsx` Inter, metadata, `<html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>`, providers. `app/page.tsx` async Server Component, fetch revalidate 3600. `app/products/page.tsx` await `searchParams: Promise<SearchParams>`, Suspe
